topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe this. There I was, pouring my heart and soul into my college application essay, thinking it was just between me and the admissions office. Then, out of nowhere, I see it—my words, my thoughts, plastered on a website, offered up as some kind of template for anyone to copy. They had no right to do that. I trusted them with my personal story, and now it’s out there, stripped of its meaning, reduced to just another example. I should have known better, but I didn’t. Now, I’m left wondering what else they’ve done with my information.
